figures.name: Nyame

ability.name: Sky God's Grace
ability.description: Restore full HP to one ally; all enemies lose 1 stat per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The all-knowing sky god who created all things and to whom all prayer ultimately rises.

figures.name: Anansi

ability.name: Story Trap
ability.description: Force one enemy to re-enact a story: they repeat their last action against their own ally.

figures.description: Spider trickster god who outwitted Sky God to own all stories in the world — the source of all human narrative.

figures.name: Asase Yaa

ability.name: Earth Mother's Truth
ability.description: No card on the field can use deception abilities; grant all earth allies +3 defense.

figures.description: Old Earth goddess of fertility and truth, Nyame's wife, who receives the dead back into her body.

figures.name: Odomankoma

ability.name: Infinite Creation
ability.description: Summon one copy of any destroyed ally from this battle at half stats.

figures.description: The infinite creator aspect of the divine who brought the universe into being from absolute nothingness.

figures.name: Bia

ability.name: First Born Wrath
ability.description: Deal 5 damage; enemies at full HP take double damage.

figures.description: The older of Nyame's two sons sent to earth, who chose force to complete the task of civilizing humanity.

figures.name: Kwaku Anansi

ability.name: Web of All Tales
ability.description: Steal any one active ability on the field and use it yourself.

figures.description: The full spider form of Anansi who climbs between earth and sky, buying wisdom from Nyame with cunning deeds.

figures.name: Nana Ama

ability.name: Sacred Stream
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies born of water or spirit type.

figures.description: River goddess associated with Saturday-born women who grants them protective powers and spiritual sight.

figures.name: Tano

ability.name: River's Cunning
ability.description: When Tano arrives: move the weakest enemy to front row; deal 3 damage to them.

figures.description: River god and second son of Nyame who tricked Death to escape and who governs the sacred Tano River.

figures.name: Sasabonsam

ability.name: Iron Hook
ability.description: Drag one enemy from any position to front row; deal 3 damage from iron hooks.

figures.description: Vampire-like forest monster with iron hooks for feet who sits in silk-cotton trees and grabs travelers.

figures.name: Mmoatia

ability.name: Invisible Healer
ability.description: Become invisible and heal one ally for 4 HP; enemy cannot target the healed ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: Tiny invisible forest fairies who taught humans medicine but can also bring illness to those who offend them.

figures.name: Osei Tutu

ability.name: Golden Stool
ability.description: All Akan allies gain +2 to all stats as long as the Golden Stool is uncontested.

figures.description: First Ashanti king whose divine right to rule descended with the Golden Stool from the sky.

figures.name: Sunsum

ability.name: Spirit Self
ability.description: This card shares the highest stat with any one ally for 2 turns.

figures.description: The personal spirit and personality essence that animates each human being, sent from Nyame.

figures.name: Osebo

ability.name: Leopard Trap
ability.description: Set a trap: the next enemy to attack this card takes 5 return damage.

figures.description: The leopard whose arrogance made him fall into Anansi's pit trap in the story of buying all stories.

figures.name: Onini

ability.name: Python Crush
ability.description: Immobilize one enemy for 1 turn; reduce their power by 2.

figures.description: The great python who boasted of his length to Anansi and was tricked into being tied to a palm branch.

figures.name: Mmoboro

ability.name: Swarm Sting
ability.description: Deal 2 damage to all enemies; they each lose 1 speed from stings.

figures.description: The hornets who Anansi tricked into his calabash by telling them the rain was coming — one of Nyame's tasks.

figures.name: Dono

ability.name: Talking Drum
ability.description: Reveal one hidden enemy card and grant one ally +2 wisdom.

figures.description: The ancestral spirit of the sacred talking drum who carries messages and preserves Akan history.

figures.name: Obiara

ability.name: Community Bond
ability.description: All allies with below-average stats gain +2 to their lowest stat.

figures.description: The spirit of every person — the divine spark of Nyame present in every living human being.

figures.name: Ananse Kokroko

ability.name: Cosmic Web
ability.description: All ability chains this turn are extended by 1 additional trigger.

figures.description: The divine cosmic form of Anansi — the great spider whose web is the structure of all creation.

figures.name: Nipa Hia

ability.name: Humility's Gift
ability.description: Remove all pride-related buffs from enemies; grant your lowest-stat ally +3 to that stat.

figures.description: The spirit of human need and humility who teaches that pride brings ruin and need brings community.

figures.name: Abrafi

ability.name: Brave Ancestor
ability.description: When any ally would be destroyed, this card may sacrifice itself to save them.

figures.description: Legendary courageous ancestor whose bravery in defense of the community was immortalized in Akan praise poetry.
